data.title: Tom Lee Says Q4 Could Bring One of the Biggest Rallies of Our Lifetime. Can Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP Reach New Highs?
data.description: Tom Lee called a historic Q4 stock rally on television, and the Fed raised rates less than 24 hours later. Now Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP face a much steeper climb than Lee's bullish case lets on.
data.keywords: XRP, Tom Lee, technology stocks, Bitcoin
